Use case: historical-scene. Native transparent FOUR-VIEW alternate injured walking pose sheet, 2x2 layout. Input atlas is ONLY Shi Qian's identity, costume, painterly camera reference. Output a NEW atlas with exactly FOUR figures, NOT a16-figure grid. Preserve this slim masked black-cloth man. Empty hands; one hand guards abdomen, tired slightly hunched torso. NO ropes, weapons, bags, props or shadow.
CRITICAL ALTERNATE FOOT POSE: In each figure, the FAR leg (on the side away from the viewer) is planted FORWARD in the body's facing direction, mostly straight. The NEAR leg (viewer side) is lifted BEHIND the hips, knee visibly bent, boot raised off ground, heel high and toes down. The lifted near boot MUST NOT be the forward planted foot. Show clear separation, not both feet together, not the reference column2 pose. This represents the opposite half of a slow short limping step: a plainly visible bend of the trailing NEAR knee, planted opposite FAR leg leading ahead. At least one distinct lifted boot above ground in EACH figure. Keep pelvis centered and body calm, not running/jumping/kicking.
TOP LEFT SE frontthreequarter down-right: planted FAR boot ahead to RIGHT, lifted NEAR boot back to LEFT. TOP RIGHT SW frontthreequarter down-left: planted FAR boot ahead to LEFT, lifted NEAR boot back to RIGHT. BOTTOM LEFT NE rearthreequarter up-right: planted FAR boot ahead to upperRIGHT, lifted NEAR boot behind to lowerLEFT. BOTTOM RIGHT NW rearthreequarter up-left: planted FAR boot ahead upperLEFT, lifted NEAR boot behind lowerRIGHT. All torsos/head point in specified facing; rear views show back. Independently drawn, no mirror duplication.
Full body in each quadrant, head/boots/cloth tails fully contained, same body height/camera, body only65% cell height, wide transparent center gutters and50px empty margins each cell. Native square<=1536. Genuine alpha TRANSPARENT background, no text/grid/borders/shadow/checkerboard/extra people. Face/mask/clothes stay consistent with input, no armor or fantasy accessories.
